headline: Bomb kills three at a Moscow restaurant, state media say
summary: An improvised device detonated at the Balzi Rossi restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square, killing three and injuring 21; Russia's embassy in Italy blamed Ukraine.
script: A bomb has killed three people at an Italian restaurant in central Moscow, injuring more than twenty. Officials say a woman tried to enter carrying the device, and a guard stopped her. Russia blames Ukraine, which has not commented.
imageAlt: A Russian National Guard vehicle parked outside the restaurant after the blast.
imageAltTwo: Security officers stand behind police tape at a nighttime emergency scene.
